# Part 3: The instruction file {background-color="#2D3748"}


## Same file, many names

The agent reads a Markdown file on startup.

| Agent | File |
|-------|------|
| **Claude Code** | `CLAUDE.md` |
| Aider | `CONVENTIONS.md` |
| Gemini CLI | `GEMINI.md` |
| Codex CLI | `AGENTS.md` |

One content, different filenames. Draft once, `cp` across agents.

Think of it as a **briefing**, not a config.


## Anatomy of a good briefing

```{=html}
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 8px; max-width: 820px; margin: 8px auto;">

<div style="background: #F0FFF4; padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px; border-left: 4px solid #48BB78;">
<strong style="color: #276749; font-size: 0.85em;">🎯 Mission</strong><br/>
<span style="font-size: 0.75em; color: #4A5568;">One paragraph. What is the project? What's the job?</span>
</div>

<div style="background: #EBF8FF; padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px; border-left: 4px solid #4299E1;">
<strong style="color: #2B6CB0; font-size: 0.85em;">📋 Principles</strong><br/>
<span style="font-size: 0.75em; color: #4A5568;">Numbered non-negotiable rules.</span>
</div>

<div style="background: #FFFFF0; padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px; border-left: 4px solid #ECC94B;">
<strong style="color: #744210; font-size: 0.85em;">🏗 Structure</strong><br/>
<span style="font-size: 0.75em; color: #4A5568;">Expected directory tree.</span>
</div>

<div style="background: #FFF5F5; padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px; border-left: 4px solid #FC8181;">
<strong style="color: #9B2C2C; font-size: 0.85em;">⚙️ Technical specs</strong><br/>
<span style="font-size: 0.75em; color: #4A5568;">Packages, output formats, SE specifications, seeds.</span>
</div>

<div style="background: #FEF5E7; padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px; border-left: 4px solid #ED8936;">
<strong style="color: #9C4221; font-size: 0.85em;">🚫 Don'ts</strong><br/>
<span style="font-size: 0.75em; color: #4A5568;">What must never happen. "Never touch data/raw/."</span>
</div>

<div style="background: #F5F3FF; padding: 10px; border-radius: 8px; border-left: 4px solid #9F7AEA;">
<strong style="color: #553C9A; font-size: 0.85em;">📞 Protocol</strong><br/>
<span style="font-size: 0.75em; color: #4A5568;">What to do when stuck. Where to log progress.</span>
</div>

</div>
```


## Example: mission & principles {.smaller}

```{.markdown}
# Replication Package Agent

## Mission
Transform the messy project folder into an AER-compliant replication
package. Reorganize code, write documentation, create a master script,
produce all tables and figures in one reproducible pipeline.

## Principles
1. Never delete or modify original data files. Copy to data/raw/.
2. All code runs from the project root using relative paths.
3. R with tidyverse. Load packages via library() in 00_setup.R only.
4. Tables: modelsummary() saved as .csv and .tex.
5. Figures: ggsave() saved as .pdf and .png at 300 DPI.
6. Standard errors: heteroskedasticity-robust unless otherwise specified.
7. Follow the AEA Social Science Data Editors README template.
```


## Example: structure & specs {.smaller}

```{.markdown}
## Project Structure
replication_package/
├── README.md              ├── code/
├── LICENSE.txt             │   ├── 00_setup.R
├── Makefile                │   ├── 01_descriptive.R
├── master.R                │   ├── 02_main_analysis.R
├── data/                   │   ├── 03_nok_analysis.R
│   ├── raw/                │   ├── 04_dmv_analysis.R
│   └── README_data.md      │   ├── 05_robustness.R
└── output/                 │   └── 06_figures.R
    ├── tables/
    └── figures/

## Don'ts
- Never modify files in data/raw/.
- No install.packages() outside 00_setup.R.
- No hardcoded absolute paths.
```

```{=html}
<div style="max-width: 820px; margin: 14px auto;">
```

## Six design rules

```{=html}
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px; max-width: 960px; margin: 8px auto;">

<div style="background: #F7FAFC; border-left: 4px solid #4299E1; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;">
<strong style="color: #2B6CB0; font-size: 0.82em;">1. Specific, not vague</strong><br/>
<span style="font-size: 0.72em; color: #4A5568;">"Clean up" ❌ → "Refactor into code/02_main_analysis.R" ✅</span>
</div>

<div style="background: #F7FAFC; border-left: 4px solid #48BB78; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;">
<strong style="color: #276749; font-size: 0.82em;">2. Show the expected tree</strong><br/>
<span style="font-size: 0.72em; color: #4A5568;">A directory tree beats 1000 words of description.</span>
</div>

<div style="background: #F7FAFC; border-left: 4px solid #ED8936; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;">
<strong style="color: #9C4221; font-size: 0.82em;">3. Define output formats</strong><br/>
<span style="font-size: 0.72em; color: #4A5568;">"Tables as .tex + .csv" / "Figures as PDF at 300 DPI"</span>
</div>

<div style="background: #F7FAFC; border-left: 4px solid #9F7AEA; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;">
<strong style="color: #553C9A; font-size: 0.82em;">4. Pin the conventions</strong><br/>
<span style="font-size: 0.72em; color: #4A5568;">AEA template sections, clustering specs, relative paths only.</span>
</div>

<div style="background: #F7FAFC; border-left: 4px solid #E53E3E; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;">
<strong style="color: #9B2C2C; font-size: 0.82em;">5. State what NOT to do</strong><br/>
<span style="font-size: 0.72em; color: #4A5568;">"Never delete original data" / "No install.packages() in scripts"</span>
</div>

<div style="background: #F7FAFC; border-left: 4px solid #ECC94B; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;">
<strong style="color: #744210; font-size: 0.82em;">6. Use an LLM to write it</strong><br/>
<span style="font-size: 0.72em; color: #4A5568;">Draft in claude.ai, then iterate: "add a section on X".</span>
</div>

</div>
```


# Part 4: Commands, skills, permissions {background-color="#2D3748"}


## Slash commands

| Command | What it does |
|---------|-------------|
| **`/plan`** | Enter planning mode. Draft, wait for approval. |
| **`/init`** | Auto-draft `CLAUDE.md` from the repo |
| **`/compact`** | Compress a long conversation to save context |
| **`/clear`** | Clear history (keep files) |
| **`/cost`** | API spend this session (or "uses Max") |
| **`/model`** | Switch opus / sonnet / haiku |
| **`/your-skill`** | Run a custom command from `.claude/commands/` |

## Custom skills

Drop a Markdown file in `.claude/commands/`. It becomes a slash command:

```{.markdown filename=".claude/commands/check-package.md"}
Verify the replication package is AER-compliant. Report pass/fail for each:

1. README.md present and follows the AEA template sections.
2. Every script referenced in README.md exists.
3. `Rscript master.R` completes without errors from a clean session.
4. Every table/figure listed in the README is produced.
5. No absolute paths, no `install.packages()` outside `00_setup.R`.
6. Data in `data/raw/` is byte-identical to the inputs.
```

Type **`/check-package`** → the agent runs the checklist. Skills travel with the repo.


## Permissions: three gears

```{=html}
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px; max-width: 900px; margin: 10px auto;">

<pre style="font-size: 0.65em; margin-top: 6px;"><code>settings.json</code></pre>
</div>

<div style="background: #FFF5F5; border: 2px solid #E53E3E; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; text-align: center;">

<p style="font-size: 0.7em; color: #4A5568; margin: 0;">Full autonomy<br/>(no prompts)</p>
<pre style="font-size: 0.65em; margin-top: 6px;"><code>--dangerously-skip-permissions</code></pre>
</div>

</div>

<p style="text-align: center; font-size: 0.76em; color: #744210; margin: 10px auto 0; max-width: 720px;">
<strong>Inside Docker, "skip all" is reasonable.</strong> The container is your sandbox; the host is untouched.
</p>
```


## settings.json allow-list

```{.json filename=".claude/settings.json"}
{
  "permissions": {
    "allow": ["Bash(Rscript:*)", "Bash(R:*)", "Bash(mkdir:*)",
              "Bash(cp:*)", "Bash(mv:*)", "Bash(make:*)",
              "Write(*)", "Read(*)"],
    "deny":  ["Bash(rm -rf /*)", "Bash(git push:*)",
              "Write(data/raw/**)"]
  }
}
```

Let the agent run R, move files, read and write. Block `rm -rf /`, `git push`, or touches to `data/raw/`.


## Hooks: enforce rules outside the prompt

```{.json filename=".claude/settings.json"}
{
  "hooks": {
    "PostToolUse": [
      { "matcher": { "tool": "Write", "path_glob": "code/*.R" },
        "command": "Rscript -e 'lintr::lint(\"$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH\")'" },
      { "matcher": { "tool": "Write", "path_glob": "data/raw/**" },
        "command": "echo 'BLOCKED: data/raw/ is read-only'; exit 1" }
    ]
  }
}
```

The harness runs these, not the agent. A rule you write once is enforced every time, even if the agent forgets it.


# Part 5: Research best practices {background-color="#2D3748"}


## The first rule: verify, don't trust

Every agent output is a **first draft from a capable but junior RA**.

```{=html}
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; max-width: 900px; margin: 8px auto;">

<div style="background: #F0FFF4; border-left: 4px solid #48BB78; padding: 12px 16px;">
<strong style="color: #276749; font-size: 0.85em; text-align: left;">✅ Do</strong>
<ul style="font-size: 0.74em; color: #4A5568; margin: 6px 0 0 0; padding-left: 16px; line-height: 1.55; text-align: left;">
<li>Read every diff before accepting.</li>
<li>Run <code>master.R</code> yourself from a clean R session.</li>
<li>Sanity-check results against known priors.</li>
<li>Spot-check regression coefficients against a prior version.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div style="background: #FFF5F5; border-left: 4px solid #FC8181; padding: 12px 16px;">
<strong style="color: #9B2C2C; font-size: 0.85em; text-align: left;">❌ Don't</strong>
<ul style="font-size: 0.74em; color: #4A5568; margin: 6px 0 0 0; padding-left: 16px; line-height: 1.55; text-align: left;">
<li>Blindly accept a 300-line diff.</li>
<li>Trust agent summaries of what it did.</li>
<li>Skip running the code yourself.</li>
<li>Let the agent be the sole author of identification decisions.</li>
</ul>
</div>

</div>
```

If you'd check an RA's first output, you check the agent's. Same rule.


## Delegate paperwork, keep the research

```{=html}
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; max-width: 940px; margin: 8px auto;">

<div style="background: #F0FFF4; border: 2px solid #48BB78; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 16px;">
<strong style="color: #276749; font-size: 0.9em; text-align: left;">🤖 Delegate</strong>
<ul style="font-size: 0.74em; color: #4A5568; margin: 6px 0 0 0; padding-left: 16px; line-height: 1.55; text-align: left;">
<li>Folder inventory, code audit</li>
<li>Bulk rewrites (rename, reformat, port API)</li>
<li>Download / parse / clean glue code</li>
<li>README and docstrings</li>
<li>Running → failing → fixing loops</li>
<li>Generating variants for comparison</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div style="background: #FFF5F5; border: 2px solid #FC8181; border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px 16px;">
<strong style="color: #9B2C2C; font-size: 0.9em; text-align: left;">🧠 Keep for yourself</strong>
<ul style="font-size: 0.74em; color: #4A5568; margin: 6px 0 0 0; padding-left: 16px; line-height: 1.55; text-align: left;">
<li>Research question and motivation</li>
<li>Identification strategy</li>
<li>Choice of estimator and SEs</li>
<li>Interpretation of results</li>
<li>Final-paper prose (voice matters)</li>
<li>Anything involving sensitive data</li>
</ul>
</div>

</div>
```

*Agents win on the paperwork around the research, not the research itself.*


## Data privacy & IRB

```{=html}
<div style="max-width: 900px; margin: 6px auto;">

<div style="background: #FFF5F5; border: 2px solid #E53E3E; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 16px;">
<h4 style="margin: 0 0 4px 0; color: #9B2C2C; font-size: 0.82em; text-align: left;">🚫 Never put these in front of a cloud agent</h4>
<ul style="font-size: 0.72em; color: #4A5568; margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; line-height: 1.45; text-align: left;">
<li>PII (names, addresses, precise geocodes)</li>
<li>IRB-restricted microdata</li>
<li>Unpublished results</li>
<li>Third-party data under NDA or restricted-use DUA</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div style="background: #F0FFF4; border: 2px solid #48BB78; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; margin-top: 10px;">
<h4 style="margin: 0 0 4px 0; color: #276749; font-size: 0.82em; text-align: left;">✅ Practical mitigations</h4>
<ul style="font-size: 0.72em; color: #4A5568; margin: 0; padding-left: 18px; line-height: 1.45; text-align: left;">
<li><strong>Anthropic:</strong> training opt-out is default for API; confirm in console settings.</li>
<li><strong>Claude Code:</strong> sensitive folders in <code>.claudeignore</code>.</li>
<li><strong>Docker:</strong> mount only what the agent needs; keep the raw extract outside.</li>
<li><strong>When in doubt, don't.</strong> Run restricted data on a local model on a secure machine.</li>
</ul>
</div>

</div>
```


## Session hygiene beats context degradation

```{=html}
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 14px; max-width: 940px; margin: 8px auto;">

<div style="background: #F7FAFC; border-left: 4px solid #4299E1; padding: 10px 14px;">
<strong style="color: #2B6CB0; font-size: 0.82em; text-align: left;">📝 Write things down</strong><br/>
<span style="font-size: 0.72em; color: #4A5568; text-align: left;">Decisions live in <code>CLAUDE.md</code> / <code>DECISIONS.md</code>, not the chat buffer.</span>
</div>

<div style="background: #F7FAFC; border-left: 4px solid #48BB78; padding: 10px 14px;">
<strong style="color: #276749; font-size: 0.82em; text-align: left;">🧹 Short sessions</strong><br/>
<span style="font-size: 0.72em; color: #4A5568; text-align: left;">Break a full replication into 5 sessions, not one 3-hour one.</span>
</div>

<div style="background: #F7FAFC; border-left: 4px solid #ED8936; padding: 10px 14px;">
<strong style="color: #9C4221; font-size: 0.82em; text-align: left;">🔄 <code>/clear</code> between topics</strong><br/>
<span style="font-size: 0.72em; color: #4A5568; text-align: left;">Context degrades. Fix with hygiene, not a bigger window.</span>
</div>

<div style="background: #F7FAFC; border-left: 4px solid #9F7AEA; padding: 10px 14px;">
<strong style="color: #553C9A; font-size: 0.82em; text-align: left;">📂 Files as handoff</strong><br/>
<span style="font-size: 0.72em; color: #4A5568; text-align: left;">Next session re-reads files, not the prior chat.</span>
</div>

</div>
```

The canonical symptom: the agent forgets a rule in `CLAUDE.md`. Fix: `/clear`, the rule is re-read on the next message.


## The "referee 2" protocol

Inspired by Scott Cunningham. Use a **second fresh session** as an independent reviewer:

```{=html}
<div style="max-width: 860px; margin: 6px auto;">
<pre style="background: #1A202C; color: #E2E8F0; padding: 14px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.65em; line-height: 1.55; text-align: left;"><span style="color: #718096"># Terminal 1: build the package</span>
$ claude --dangerously-skip-permissions
<span style="color: #ED8936">▸</span> (builds replication_package/)

<span style="color: #718096"># Terminal 2: fresh session, clean context</span>
$ claude
<span style="color: #ED8936">▸</span> You are a referee for the AEA Data Editor. Review
  /workspace/replication_package/ against the AEA template.
  Check: README sections, master.R runs clean, tables produced,
  packages listed with versions. Report pass/fail for each item.</pre>
</div>
```

A fresh context has no bias from the construction. Cheapest code review you'll ever run.


## Reproducibility is the point

```{=html}
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 12px; max-width: 940px; margin: 6px auto;">

<div style="background: #F0FFF4; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px;">
<strong style="color: #276749; font-size: 0.82em; text-align: left;">Git is your safety net</strong>
<ul style="font-size: 0.72em; color: #4A5568; margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 16px; line-height: 1.55; text-align: left;">
<li>Commit frequently. Hit Esc and re-prompt if a diff looks wrong.</li>
<li>Commit <code>CLAUDE.md</code> and custom skills. They're part of the repo.</li>
<li>A clean git log <em>is</em> the audit trail.</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div style="background: #EBF8FF; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 14px;">
<strong style="color: #2B6CB0; font-size: 0.82em; text-align: left;">Environment is your truth</strong>
<ul style="font-size: 0.72em; color: #4A5568; margin: 4px 0 0 0; padding-left: 16px; line-height: 1.55; text-align: left;">
<li>Docker image pins R + system libs.</li>
<li><code>renv::snapshot()</code> pins package versions.</li>
<li>Always test from a <em>clean</em> R session, not yours.</li>
</ul>
</div>

</div>
```

Cardinal AEA rule: *"Reproduce the tables and figures by running the code without manual intervention, starting from the raw data."*


## Prompt patterns that work

```{=html}
<div style="max-width: 940px; margin: 6px auto;">
<table style="width: 100%; font-size: 0.72em; border-collapse: collapse;">
<thead>
<tr style="background: #EDF2F7;">
<th style="padding: 5px 10px; text-align: left;">Pattern</th>
<th style="padding: 5px 10px; text-align: left;">Example</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td style="padding: 5px 10px; text-align: left;"><strong>Vague → iterate</strong></td><td style="padding: 5px 10px; text-align: left;">"I want X. Ask anything unclear, then do it."</td></tr>
<tr><td style="padding: 5px 10px; text-align: left;"><strong>Scripts, not commands</strong></td><td style="padding: 5px 10px; text-align: left;">"Write <code>download_data.R</code>", not "download the data"</td></tr>
<tr><td style="padding: 5px 10px; text-align: left;"><strong>Style by reference</strong></td><td style="padding: 5px 10px; text-align: left;">"Follow Kieran Healy's ggplot2 conventions"</td></tr>
<tr><td style="padding: 5px 10px; text-align: left;"><strong>Small iterations</strong></td><td style="padding: 5px 10px; text-align: left;">Three narrow prompts beat one monster prompt</td></tr>
<tr><td style="padding: 5px 10px; text-align: left;"><strong>Context → goal → constraints</strong></td><td style="padding: 5px 10px; text-align: left;">"This replicates X. Refactor scripts. Relative paths only."</td></tr>
<tr><td style="padding: 5px 10px; text-align: left;"><strong>Show, don't tell</strong></td><td style="padding: 5px 10px; text-align: left;">A directory tree beats paragraphs of description</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
```


## Model economics

| Task | Good choice |
|------|-------------|
| `/plan` on a hard refactor | **Opus** |
| Everyday execution | **Sonnet** (default for today) |
| Small edits, tight loops | **Haiku** |

Use `/plan` on Opus, then `/model sonnet` after approving. On Max, this costs nothing extra; on API, it's the single biggest cost-saver.

Want to compare to a non-Claude model (DeepSeek Reasoner, GPT-5)? See the **Aider + OpenRouter appendix** in the tutorial.

## Do / don't

```{=html}
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 16px; max-width: 820px; margin: 8px auto;">

<div style="background: #F0FFF4; border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px;">
<h4 style="margin: 0 0 6px 0; color: #276749; font-size: 0.88em; text-align: left;">✅ Do</h4>
<ul style="font-size: 0.78em; color: #4A5568; margin: 0; padding-left: 16px; line-height: 1.55; text-align: left;">
<li>Read the messy files before starting</li>
<li>Start with <code>/plan</code> and review</li>
<li>Iterate: "fix X", "add Y", "change Z"</li>
<li>Check <code>/cost</code> between steps</li>
<li>Add a <code>/check-package</code> skill</li>
<li>Run the code yourself in a clean shell</li>
</ul>
</div>

<div style="background: #FFF5F5; border-radius: 10px; padding: 14px;">
<h4 style="margin: 0 0 6px 0; color: #9B2C2C; font-size: 0.88em; text-align: left;">❌ Don't</h4>
<ul style="font-size: 0.78em; color: #4A5568; margin: 0; padding-left: 16px; line-height: 1.55; text-align: left;">
<li>Give vague instructions</li>
<li>Skip the briefing file</li>
<li>Argue with the model; just hit Esc and re-prompt</li>
<li>Let one session run for three hours</li>
<li>Trust the agent's own summary of what it did</li>
<li>Put restricted data in front of a cloud model</li>
</ul>
</div>

</div>
```


## Bonus challenges

::: {.panel-tabset}

### 1. Referee 2
Build with Claude Code, then open a second fresh `claude` session and have it audit `/workspace/replication_package/` against the AEA template. What did it flag that you missed?

### 2. Custom skills
Create `.claude/commands/` with:

- `/check-package`: verify AER compliance
- `/compare-output`: summarise generated tables
- `/referee`: run the referee 2 checklist

### 3. Your own project
Take one of your half-finished research projects. Draft a `CLAUDE.md`. Ask the agent to inventory it and propose a reorganisation *without executing*. Read the plan. What does it see that you missed?

### 4. Compare model families
With the Aider + OpenRouter appendix, re-run today's task on DeepSeek Reasoner or GPT-5. Compare plan quality, diffs, and cost against your Claude Sonnet run.

:::

```{=html}
<div style="text-align: left;"><strong>Custom skills travel with the repo.</strong> Version-control your checks.</div>

<div style="font-size: 1.3em;">🧠</div>
<div style="text-align: left;"><strong>Delegate the paperwork, keep the research.</strong> You verify; the agent types.</div>

<div style="font-size: 1.3em;">🤝</div>
<div style="text-align: left;"><strong>Referee 2.</strong> A fresh session is the cheapest code review you'll ever run.</div>

</div>
</div>
```
